subject.title: ci: defer macOS tests for draft pull requests

question: May the protected aggregate CI check be green for a code-changing draft while macOS validation is deferred, and does the repository's merge configuration reliably require the new ready-for-review run before that unchanged SHA can merge?
rationale: The code correctly implements the proposed policy, but tests cannot establish the repository's intended branch-protection semantics or eliminate configuration-dependent reuse of a successful check on the same commit.

options.title: Approve explicit draft deferral
options.body: Accept the green deferred state after confirming that ready-for-review or merge-queue processing requires the fresh macOS-backed aggregate run before merge.

options.title: Add a readiness guard
options.body: Require a distinct check or other configuration that cannot remain satisfied by the earlier draft run when the pull request becomes ready.

options.title: Keep macOS running on drafts
options.body: Decline the capacity optimization and retain macOS validation for every code-changing pull request state.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit draft deferral
recommendation.body: Accept the green deferred state after confirming that ready-for-review or merge-queue processing requires the fresh macOS-backed aggregate run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available authority for protected-check and hosted-runner policy.
